text:
elaine: Quick sync after hallway feedback. New idea: split actions into Primary (Export) and Secondary strip (Copy ID, Open) to reduce accidental exports. How does that feel?
noah: I like separating primary vs secondary. Makes exporting deliberate.
ken: Concern: support will lose efficiency if Copy ID moves out of immediate header. It's a common action during incident triage.
lucy: Maybe keep Copy ID visible but visually de-emphasize it (secondary button). Keep Open in More.
sam: Accessibility: ensure Copy ID still first tabbable element after heading even if styled secondary. Focus order matters more than visual prominence.
elaine: Agreed. I'll try primary + secondary layout and post.
